description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing and representing Mach-O binary files, including extracting attributes and sections, and integrating with the MISP framework.

classes.name: MachOObject
classes.description: Represents a Mach-O binary object, capable of extracting attributes and sections using lief.

classes.name: MachOSectionObject
classes.description: Represents a section within a Mach-O binary, extracting attributes like name, size, and hashes.

methods.name: make_macho_objects
methods.description: Creates MachOObject and MachOSectionObjects from a lief parsed binary and adds references to a FileObject.

methods.name: generate_attributes
methods.description: Extracts and adds attributes such as type, entry point, and section info to the object.
